kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-alarm-list --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-pe33e0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAlarmList

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
要操作的WAF实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

Cause.description_en:
The cause of the alert. Valid values:

fivefold: The QPS exceeds the limit of the current WAF instance specifications.

4count: The actual QPS has cumulatively exceeded the limit of the current WAF instance specifications.

exceed10w: The peak QPS exceeds 100,000.

costProtection: Billing protection is triggered
Cause.description_zh:
告警原因。取值为：

fivefold: 表示业务的QPS已超过当前规格。
4count：表示实际业务请求数QPS已累计超过当前规格。
exceed10w: 表示实际业务请求峰值QPS已超过10万。
costProtection: 表示触发计费保护

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the alert. This is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
EndTime.description_zh: 告警结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒

MaxQps.description_en: The peak QPS during the alert period

Spec.description_en: The QPS limit of the current WAF instance specifications

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the alert. This is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
StartTime.description_zh: 告警开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒

Status.description_en:
The current status of the alert. Valid values:

1: The queries per second (QPS) limit is exceeded.

2: The WAF instance enters the sandbox.

3: The WAF instance is removed from the sandbox.

4: The QPS no longer exceeds the limit
Status.description_zh:
告警当前状态。取值为：

1：表示QPS超用。
2：表示进入沙箱。
3：表示从沙箱移出。
4：表示从QPS超用移出

Type.description_en:
The type of the alert. Valid value:

qps: a QPS alert
Type.description_zh:
告警类型。取值为：

qps: 表示业务的QPS告警
